law: EVERYTHING means EVERYTHING. EVERY BYTE means EVERY BYTE. Zero undeclared loss.

ingress.hard_rules: blueprint HARD RULES 10-12: nu_plugin/CodeDB is the byte-complete ingress; hashes/manifests supplement, never replace bytes

declared_exclusions.reason: No byte stream exists to capture; presence+metadata recorded (path, type, mode, owner, mtime)
Live runtime pids/sockets; volatile by definition; metadata recorded

Live PG datadir cannot ingest itself mid-write (self-recursion + torn pages). Bytes ARE captured — via pg_basebackup consistent snapshot imported as the datadir's byte representation, plus WAL. Declared transform, not loss.
Mid-write SQLite files captured from a quiesced copy (sqlite3 .backup or fs snapshot) to avoid torn reads. Declared transform, not loss.

reconciliation.db_inventory_query: select r.module_path as path, b.bytes as byte_len, b.sha256 from lifeos_runtime.codebase_codedb_path_refs r join lifeos_runtime.codebase_codedb_blobs b on b.sha256 = r.sha256
reconciliation.path_mapping: codedb stores repo-relative module_path per capture root; reconcile joins fs path = <capture_root>/<module_path> using the wave ledger of capture roots
reconciliation.denied_class_manifest: files codedb declines (classifier-secret, and uncertain when policy says metadata-only) are recorded with exact_source_sha256 + byte length from the capture CSV ledger; they are DECLARED entries pending secret-plane capture, not losses
reconciliation.acceptance: every regular file under scope appears in DB with matching sha256+len, or matches exactly one declared exclusion or the denied-class ledger; zero undeclared loss

witness: SHAKE256 session witness per capture batch (blueprint invariant 12)
